verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's docs show you can choose among multiple GPU instance types: Capacity Finder compares availability across "one or more GPU and CPU instance types", and separate Node Pools can run on different Node types. A community comment adds that the fleet is "all datacenter GPUs". However, nothing in the pack names any GPU model or generation, so the story's core claim about specific GPU classes is unproven. Missing for 10: any evidence of H100/H200/B200-class availability, any evidence of cheaper previous-generation GPU options, and pricing by GPU type.
